# mock-items-search — generated skardi bundle

Generated by `skardi-etl` from a `kind: etl` config. Everything here is a
plain skardi artifact — read it, edit it, version-control it. Regenerating
with the same config reproduces this bundle byte-for-byte; `generate`
refuses to overwrite a non-empty directory without `--force`.

## Contents

- `setup.sql` — destination DDL: the `documents` table plus the engine's
  search artifacts and sync triggers. Idempotent (`IF NOT EXISTS`).
- `jobs/` — one `kind: job` per source table (chunk + embed inline in SQL).
- `pipelines/` — `mock-items-search-search-hybrid` (RRF) and `mock-items-search-get-document`.
- `ctx.fragment.yaml` — the data-source entry to merge into your `ctx.yaml`.

## Run it (five steps)

```bash
# 1. Apply the destination DDL (idempotent; --reset rebuilds).
#    sqlite-vec must be loadable for the vec0 table:
#    export SQLITE_VEC_PATH=/absolute/path/to/vec0.dylib
skardi-etl setup -f setup.sql --dest data/gh.db

# 2. Merge ctx.fragment.yaml's data_sources entry into your ctx.yaml.

# 3. Serve the bundle.
skardi-server --ctx ctx.yaml --jobs jobs/ --pipeline pipelines/

# 4. Ingest (append-only; {limit} bounds each run).
skardi job run mock-items-search-ingest-items -p limit=500

# 5. Search.
skardi run mock-items-search-search-hybrid \
  -p query="vector databases" -p text_query="vector databases" \
  -p vector_weight=0.5 -p text_weight=0.5 -p limit=10
# Every hit carries (source_table, source_id) — fetch the whole document:
skardi run mock-items-search-get-document -p source_table=<t> -p source_id=<id>
```

The query vector embeds with `models/generated/bge-small-en-v1.5` — the same model the ingest jobs
used; changing the embedding config is a rebuild, not an edit.

## Refresh

The v1 refresh model is rebuild-first: `skardi-etl setup -f setup.sql \
--dest data/gh.db --reset` drops every bundle-owned artifact and
re-applies the DDL; then re-run the jobs.

- `mock-items-search-ingest-items` is full-load (its pack exposes no timestamp pushdown): refresh = `skardi-etl setup --reset` + re-run. `{limit}` bounds each run.

`doc_id` (`<source_table>:<source_id>:<chunk_index>`) is deterministic but
deliberately NOT unique in v1 — replay accumulates rows instead of
hard-failing mid-job, and reads deduplicate. A chunking-config change moves
chunk boundaries: that is a rebuild.

## Troubleshooting

- **`generate --force` crashed mid-swap?** Your previous bundle is intact
  in a sibling `<out>.etl-bak-<pid>` directory; recover it with a single
  rename (`mv <out>.etl-bak-<pid> <out>`). There is never a half-written
  output directory.
- **`no such module: vec0`** — the sqlite-vec extension isn't loadable;
  set the extension env var (see `ctx.fragment.yaml`) and re-apply setup.
- **Search returns stale/duplicate-looking rows** — expected under
  incremental overlap; reads keep each chunk's best copy. `--reset` +
  re-run clears history completely.

Destination: `gh_search` → `data/gh.db`.
